content_sections.heading: IIMK Campus Security Manager Recruitment 2026 - Overview

rows.indian_institute_of_management_kozhikode: Graduation in any discipline with experience in Defence/Para Military forces / Police / PSU / Industrial Organization / Educational Institution
35 to 55 years (as on last date for receiving application)

content_sections.heading: IIMK Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. C-80/2026-IIMK.HR gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IIMK notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduation in any discipline (including graduate degree awarded for defence personnel - JCO's & equivalent need apply) Experience: At least 15 years' experience in Defence/Para Military forces / Police / PSU/ Industrial Organization/ Educational Institution of which at least three years as a Security Officer / Supervisory Level in a large organization where 50 or more personnel were deployed. Age limit: 35 to 55 years (as on last date for receiving application) Other conditions: Should be able to write reports in English and have good communication skills in English, Hindi & Malayalam. Should have basic knowledge in operating computer. Should be able to monitor CCTV feeds. Expected to go beyond the call of duty and extend work hours in cases of emergency. Should be able to work in different shifts as and when required. Desirable: Candidate holding a Diploma in Fire Safety and Security Management. Retired personnel who have served in CISF as an officer or JCO and equivalent ranks. Ex-service personnel of Military/ Para Military Forces / Police department / PSU/ Industrial Organization having served in a Group A or Group B Posts. Knowledge and practical handling of firefighting equipment's and emergency response. Expertise in risk management, incident response, and regulatory compliance. Technical proficiency in modern security systems and tools.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely on contract basis for an initial period of one year. Further extensions will be subject to job requirements and performance.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: How Will IIMK Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening of applications Interview for shortlisted candidates Academic & professional profiles submitted will be shortlisted for the selection process and interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIMK Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates may submit applications online at https://iimk.ac.in/ latest by 5:00 pm of 20.10.2026. Upload photograph, CV, certificates and signature as per the format prescribed in the online portal. Send it on or before 20 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Canvassing in any form and/or bringing in any influence will automatically disqualify the candidate.
